about: Third-party design skills the visual-redesign method calls (recorded 2026-11-19 from the Ride The Bus, PTrainr and EzAutoApply checkouts and their skills-lock.json). They are NOT vendored here: each repo installs what it needs with `npx skills add <source>` (see the find-skills skill) and keeps its own lock. `step` is the step of the loop in visual-redesign/skill.shared.md. `installedIn` is what was true on the date above.
